shared_elements: horizontal or stacked bands of pattern
justification: The main shared content is only generic: both surfaces include repeated schematic signs with rectilinear and rounded elements arranged in bands or rows. The biggest difference is that A prominently depicts recognizable animals and bird-like figures in profile around a patterned band, while B is dominated by a dense grid/column of abstract glyph-like blocks with no comparable animal scene or iconographic relationships.
